newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pinnacle estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pinnacle estimates cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said analyst Doug van Dorsten cut his December and March quarter estimates -- the second and third quarters of fiscal 1997, respectively -- for Pinnacle Systems Inc due to "weaker than expected demand from Avid" Technology Inc for Pinnacle's Alladin 3D video editing system.

-- He reduced the Dec. quarter earnings estimate to a loss of $0.05 a share on revenue of $8.1 million from a profit of $0.08 on revenue of $11.5 million. He cut the March quarter estimate to a profit of $0.13 a share from $0.16 a share.
-- His estimate for all of fiscal 1997, ending June, fell to a profit of $0.43 a share from a previous $0.57 a share.
